description: This PHP source file defines a class `TokenGenerator` in the namespace `OrangeHRM\Authentication\Csrf`. The class extends `UriSafeTokenGenerator` from Symfony's Security CSRF component and is intended to generate CSRF tokens in a URI-safe manner, as part of the authentication security features within the OrangeHRM system.
